* [ ] I am authorized to use the target or destination associated with this subdomain.
* [ ] The subdomain will not be used for spam, phishing, malware, impersonation, or other prohibited activity.
* [ ] I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://is-at-the.top/terms).
